notes.title: Farmer's Life Summer Update
notes.notes: [h3]Working on the farm has never been so fun. The sun is shining, not too cold, not too warm, before the Summer Holidays... and with an Update![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/aaf6caf7762c9c941c9c663077fc752d6d1ab8fd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]What's changed[/u] in Farmer's Life Update 1.0.34[/h3][p][/p][p]- Thadeus has an idea for a new invention: the Mechanical Chainsaw. Before he starts selling it, however, you'll need to complete a few tasks for him.[/p][p]- Helen also has an idea for a new invention: the Cigarette Roller. Once mounted on a work stool, it greatly simplifies the process of producing tobacco products — but first, you'll need to finish a few jobs for Helen.[/p][p]- Hand-rolling cigarettes can now be done not only with the mouse, but also using the up/down keys or the forward/backward joystick axis.[/p][p]- Kasimir has finally overcome his fear of jumping. If he builds up enough speed and isn't overburdened, he can even jump over fences! (Some activities prevent jumping.)[/p][p]- Kasimir realized the attic in his old house has stood unused for years. It can now be accessed and used via an outside entry.[/p][p]- Kasimir has learned to organize space better, so all cabinets, dressers, and other furniture now have double the capacity.[/p][p]- Kasimir can now access item containers even while standing on a ladder.[/p][p]- Stefan discovered that the ladders he sells were too long and cumbersome for some people. From now on, he also offers medium and short versions.[/p][p]- Stan from the State Farm has — completely free of charge (!) — mounted small toolboxes on all of Kasimir’s tractors for the most essential tools.[/p][p]- Fences built by Kasimir now try their best to look better on uneven terrain. Still not perfect, but an improvement nonetheless.[/p][p]- Kasimir has learned to search wild dumps more thoroughly. In addition to scrap, he now finds bottles, jars, boards, and other small items.[/p][p]- When selling directly from wagons, items that the merchant isn't interested in are now greyed out, just like in regular hand-to-hand trade.[/p][p]- Plows and harrows "sample" the soil more frequently, leaving fewer missed patches.[/p][p]- Kasimir can now choose the color of livestock he wants to purchase.[/p][p]- Kasimir discovered that straw can be used to line animal pens using a pitchfork. This improves cleanliness, post-birth recovery, milk yield, and wool regrowth.[/p][p]- Kasimir also found that feeders can be placed in pens in such a way that they don’t get in the animals’ way (i.e., near the doors or the opposite side).[/p][p]- The issue with animals crowding into a single stall in the barn has been resolved. You’ll just need to rescue them one last time.[/p][p]- The same fix applies to animals “automatically” returning to stalls they shouldn't — unless your wife has told them to.[/p][p]- Automatic milkers will no longer attempt to milk bulls, male goats. Or calves.[/p][p]- Automatic milkers no longer appear in regular old animal pens (in brick buildings).[/p][p]- The spots where you removed old fences near the house can now be cultivated like any other soil.[/p][p]- The “Fresh Milk” quest (for Sophia) now accepts either a cow or a goat and also counts milk from automatic milkers.[/p][p]- Maria at the State Farm now buys strawberries.[/p][p]- Turns out some prankster painted our male geese to look like barnacle geese. After a bath, it’s clear they’re just normal saddleback males.[/p][p]- Wives no longer walk around barefoot after coming back from work.[/p][p]- Floating socks in the yard should no longer haunt Kasimir’s farm.[/p][p]- Cats and dogs can now enter Kasimir’s house. Cats sleep in the kitchen — whether Kasimir likes it or not.[/p][p]- Save file deletion is now much more convenient. You can even delete all files at once — so be careful![/p][p][/p][p]So let's get started:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137750/Farmers_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy your farming,[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.26
notes.notes:
[h3]Important[/h3]
After the 1.0.24 update, all players noticed "plowed" and untouchable areas next to the barn on Kasimir's farm. This is a side effect of our tests. It has ben reverted, but some of you may need to re-plow these areas using any method.

We remind you that if there is more than one animal in a stall at a time, take out the ones you can using "take animal out" and for the rest, use the lead option and take advantage of fast travel.
From now on, they shouldn't experience this shared overnight stay anymore.

Chickens are avoiding the use of teleportation, so if they’re stuck somewhere, you’ll need to help them. Or end their suffering if they’re out of your reach.

[h3]Zmiany[/h3]
- The cultivator no longer behaves as if it’s still working after being detached from the tractor.
- Falling off the bicycle no longer results in a Buddha-like effect or strange positions while continuing to ride.
- Building construction now removes not only grass but also larger vegetation.
- Chickens no longer treat doors to concrete buildings as if they don't exist.
- The shape of entry ramps to concrete buildings has been improved, so poultry should no longer have trouble getting inside.
- The two-wheeled cart has been "calmed down" a bit, but in collisions with other equipment, it can still explode. We're investigating the issue and will implement the necessary fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.25
notes.notes:
- Loading save files from before the update should no longer cause issues.
- Kazimierz's movement has returned to normal.
- Using fast travel on a bicycle no longer ends with a trip to the sky or beneath the terrain.

[b]Important[/b]
If you played and saved the game after receiving a message about an incorrectly loaded file, I suggest starting from a save file made before the update.
This will help you avoid unexpected losses that may have occurred due to the incorrect file loading.

Before releasing the update, we tested many of your save files, but as you can see, not thoroughly enough.
We sincerely apologize for the problems caused.

notes.title: Update 1.0.24
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ty9eE0Fbl7E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Clothes[/b]
- Kasimir has discovered that he can live without his beloved cap on his head. In fact, the rest of his clothes can also be swapped for something else.
- Clothing affects body temperature. During harsh winters, a bearskin outfit will allow long hours outdoors. But on hot days, it's better to wear something lighter. Or nothing at all.
- Johnny at the Zalesie market has started selling clothes. If you want to look like the Mayor, be sure to talk to our toolsmith.
- If winter is raging in your game right now, at least get yourself a sweater.
- Kasimir can now set up a new station: the sewing workshop. Only here can clothes be made from the skins of hunted animals. You can also create woolen string and dresses.
- As part of Johnny's tasks, you can obtain two types of military uniforms.
- Kasimir can gift selected clothing to the women of Zalesie, and they will put it on immediately.
- Kasimir's wife changes into something more comfortable for the night than her work clothes.
- When winter comes, the residents of Zalesie dress appropriately instead of freezing in light clothing.
- Kasimir now reacts to temperature changes faster, so it no longer takes several hours by the stove to warm up.

[b]Third person camera (optional)[/b]
- While driving vehicles and riding animals, you can now switch between first-person and third-person camera views.
- Regardless of the work mode, the camera now behaves differently, no longer shaking with the vehicle, making the ride more enjoyable.
- Yes, you can now see Kazimierz in his current outfit not only during outfit changes but also while riding.
- No, you won't be seeing a third-person camera while walking anytime soon.

[b]Other[/b]
- A long-awaited option has appeared in the graphic settings: antialiasing, with several variants.
- Kasimir has learned how to sort items in his vast bag, making it easier to find things.
- If Kasimir misses a needlessly sold tractor or another unusual vehicle, he can always talk to Stan and buy back the chosen machines.
- Kasimir discovered that the music records he owns contain additional tracks he hadn't heard before!
- Horses now only use bridles and harnesses when they are actually needed.
- Agricultural machines once again provide resistance during operation.
- Animals (yes, including chickens and roosters) now have much fewer opportunities to escape from their pens or disappear.
- Animals will no longer appear in the same stalls. However, if you've already experienced this, lead out those you can, and rescue the rest by leading them and using fast travel.
- Memory usage during gameplay has been significantly reduced.

notes.title: Update 1.0.21
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=07NR_rSA2Lc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Kasimir can now arrange the interior of the old barn as he wishes. You can even remove all the stalls and set up a moonshine distillery inside.
- Kasimir has learned to build a new type of building using concrete blocks.
- Kasimir has learned to build simple dog houses for his dogs.

- A cart hitched to a horse still sways. Exactly as in reality. We've checked.
- Pulling bags, boxes, crates, and barrels straight from the inventory near machines no longer causes them to fly off into space.
- You can now sell the s60 engine, table saw, and chopper to the residents who sell them.
- You can sell the old tractor, new tractor, motorcycle, and even the combine harvester to Stan at the State Agricultural Farm (SAF). Such a sale is irreversible!
- Using solvent on the floor no longer removes wallpaper and paint from the entire interior.
- You can no longer paint the floor. It may have looked nicer, but it led to unpleasant consequences.
- You can no longer accidentally mow tree seedlings with a scythe. You have to take a shovel and dig them up.
- You can now rotate bales of straw or hay while holding them in your hands. They also don’t fall from the attics when the player moves too far away.
- The building and station destruction mode now gives time to react to stop the process if it is used on the wrong object by mistake.
- You can now use fast travel while holding a ladder in your hands.
- Animals should now stop disappearing. They may still change their position in surprising ways. We are working to ensure they stay in their enclosures.
- Steven now offers a larger amount of asbestos sheets and concrete blocks.
- Metal stalls for animals in concrete buildings no longer change into wooden ones without reason.
- Interior furnishings introduced by DLC no longer duplicate.
- You can no longer use "Take all" when the item quantity slider is open.
- The issue with the game not recognizing the horse being led into the stall (in the introduction) has finally been identified and eliminated.
- Trees planted by Kasimir, after being cut down and the stump dug out with a shovel, no longer leave an eternally "treed" spot.
- Stacks of grass, hay, etc., hold 40 units of the resource. The same as a single bale of the resource.
- Inside new farm buildings, it no longer rains.
- Machines overturned in an unfortunate manner are easier to set upright.
- The description of a fresh egg no longer causes confusion regarding poultry breeding. All you need is a rooster and a flock of hens. Eggs do not participate in the process.
- In addition to the above, we have managed to identify and fix a huge number of bugs. Of course, all thanks to you, dear players!

[h3]Coming soon[/h3]
- Cultivator.
- Concrete, multi-stall pigsty.
- New types of roofing materials.

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- We've improved the readability of the information conveyed in the game's introduction.
- Kazimierz has learned how to build two new types of garage sheds. They are perfect as a garage for a combine harvester or as a roof for distillery farms.
- Physically active stacks of items (barrels, bags, boxes, cubes, etc.) now constitute an obstacle for animal navigation.
- While plowing with horses, it's no longer necessary to manually ensure the camera is facing the right direction.
- Pop-up notifications are now more readable.
- Dead animals left on the ground decompose on their own after a few months.
- In the summer, herbivorous animals become hungry much slower, but they do not replace the mower or scythe. Grass still needs to be removed manually.
- Unwanted stacks of hay, grass, straw, etc., can be removed by burning them with the help of a kerosene lamp. The same applies to cubes and hay drying racks. The racks themselves are fire-resistant.
- Chaff cutters and threshers can be loaded by throwing the appropriate items onto them, both in cubes and in loose form using forks.
- Mowing now generates significantly less grass. This applies to both the scythe and the mower, as well as the combine harvester.
- Grass and its rotting derivatives do not turn into rotten mush after winter but simply decompose and disappear without a trace.
- It's possible to spear cubes on forks and throw them. The cubes, not the forks.
- Animals can now be cleaned by dousing them with water from a bucket.
- It's now possible to milk cows and goats without taking them out of their stalls. Remember, even locked stalls can feed... remotely. Just let them out for a walk sometimes, ok?
- Kazimierz can use fast travel even when overloaded. But travelling on foot, on bike or an animal might take more time, depending on carried weight.
- The sound range of animal footsteps is now significantly reduced.
- Two new volume sliders have appeared in the settings: for our "dialogs" (otherwise known as mumbling) and for Kazimierz's footsteps.
- The range of the mouse sensitivity slider in the settings has been significantly widened.
- The availability of scrap at Stefan's and the twins at the sawmill has increased.
- The production of vodka (based on oat mash) is now just as profitable as the production of other alcohols.
- Using the map through the inventory button no longer drops the boxes carried in hands, allowing for the use of fast travel with boxes in hands when playing with a controller.
- Picking up items from wagons or trailers will no longer cause explosions or jittering. However, a solid displacement of the vehicle can still occur, because Kazek is really a strong guy.
- Priest Mateusz has discovered a new tradition of the Kazimierz family and has an idea for a related new task.

notes.title: Developers' view of the latest update
notes.notes:
Dear Farmer's Life fans,

First of all, we would like to apologize to unsatisfied players about the latest update. You certainly want to know why some of the changes are controversial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/8f5112105c9a15a73a1bb890399549909737f815.jpg[/img]

At the beginning of our journey, and even after the game's release in early access on Steam, we never expected that such a large number of fantastic players would take interest in our game, create a thriving community, and play, play, play, and play some more. Due to the fact that we are a small studio, on the one hand this is our first experience with such player support, on the other hand, when releasing/designing the game it was difficult to predict that a few years later there may be a situation of stability and performance problems due to, for example, too many animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/8c731e1ecbb8e33dccab8ebcbae1df92adab0925.png[/img]

Our intention has never been to make the enjoyment of the game unpleasant for players, but to provide constantly new experiences but also challenges. For the aforementioned reason, an update allowing us to continue adding content had to come. We were so anxious for you to have fun that it comes too late. We understand your bitterness, we treat everything with the utmost seriousness and promise that with this update, others with numerous and interesting mechanics, equipment and events will come soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35624648/95c3f6de8294c1d033db58f8a68187226e9a889c.png[/img]

We hope you will understand, and continue to support us, and we will continue to work hard and provide you with constantly new experiences, with the lowest possible percentage of those
negative ones.

Remember, you can always contact us on discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Ev42djcSNH]Discord[/url].

Greetings,
Farmer's Life team

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- We got rid of a pest eating most of potato plants. Now the potatoes present themselves properly.
- A mysterious pea disease forcing it to a full growth right from the start was eliminated.
- You can load cut wheat on your carts now.
- You can use fast-travel while working a seeder connected to a horse. This way you can avoid a very-not-fast-travel to bring the seeder home.
- Helping a cow give birth no longer puts Kasimir in an altered state of consciousness so he doesn't leave his body to sightsee the heavens.

notes.title: Update 0.6.50
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IvYEa2G2MFk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- There is a State Agricultural Farm in Zalesie, also known as SAF (look in the east).
- There is a new machine in Zalesie: Seeder. You may connect it to a tractor or to a horse.
- There are no sale limit at SAF, but they pay less than your friend from Zalesie.
- You can buy new animals at SAF: bull, ram and buck.
- You can breed animals, just keep them well fed. If they are hungry all they think about is food.
- All the animals you own may be sold at animal trader at SAF. Caution, skinny and dirty beasts won't fetch high prices.
- Players industrious enough may influence product prices now.
- SAF's boss grants interesting contracts to complete (available from January to the end of March).
- Crops have been seriously optimized, so Kasimir may finally go crazy in the farming department.
- Animals got another batch of training and should stop using magical tricks to escape pens and boxes.
- Phillip has two new tasks for Kasimir.
- You can no longer steal apples from orchards that don't belong to you.
- Kasimir learned how to pack hens and roosters back to boxes.
- He also learned how to put oat and wheat grains into sacks instead of dropping one piece at a time...
- The largest number of bugs so far has been eliminated. Thank you very much for the numerous submissions!

notes.title: Update 0.6.08
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- There is a new crop in Zalesie: Tobacco.
- Bikes and tractors have lights now (L key by default but you can reconfigure it in settings).
- Tractor lost its ability to drive into machines it pulls. So did the horses and bikes.
- A snow lover who kept bringing snow into the bunker by the church is frozen dead now.
- Missing translations were finally added.
- A dead stork left in the slaughter is no longer a problem and savegames with such situation will load properly now.
- The cut down willows are back to normal behaviour. Remember, you need to cut all of the branches first if you want to chop the stem.
- Hand pulled cart is no longer able to tear away from hinges and take away doors of any size.
- Several bugs reported by You were eliminated.

notes.title: Update 0.6.05
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- There is a new machine in Zalesie: Three-row plow. Only a tractor is able to pull it.
- Plows no longer stops plowing upon contact with a single lump of grass (but you still need to cut the grass before plowing).
- Pitchforks are easier to use now and it's easier to pin stuff on them.
- Traders' daily buy limits were increased.
- Storks came to Zalesie.
- Distilleries no longer turn all alcohols into cider.
- You can no longer sleep or equip items while driving a vehicle or an animal.
- Ann will accept even an ordinary broth as part of her cooking quest task.
- Animals are not afraid to enter stalls with gunk laying inside (but they get dirty on contact).

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
- Some translations are missing. We will update them soon.

notes.title: Update 0.6.02
notes.notes: - Phillip sells female goats from now on. You can keep your males of course, especially if you want to build a goat empire one day.

notes.title: Update 0.6.01
notes.notes:
- Sheep and goats know what the feeding rack full of food is good for
- If Fluffy flown away or is simply missing there is a chance it will reappear on your farm

notes.title: Update 0.6.00
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Fluffy learned how to pull a small cart. Together with Kasimir they got quite robust transport potential.
- There is a new crop in Zalesie: Wheat.
- There is a new machine in Zalesie: Mower. You can attach it both to a tractor and a horse.
- You can buy three new animals in Zalesie: a sheep, a goat and a rooster.
- You can trim sheeps, milk goats and... listen to roosters.
- Kasimir learned how to pull some of his machines like the plow, the mower or the horse cart.
- Kasimir learned how to manufacture cigarettes and found out that some of the villagers like to smoke.
- You can no longer connect a cart, a plow and a mower to a tractor at the same time (the same applies to horses).
- New farm animals in Zalesie come in different colors now (must be a mutation caused by the moonshine).
- Kasimir discovered he doesn't have to be drunk to ride animals. And that not only pigs are mountable.
- Phillip has a proposition for Kasimir to play a weird competition. 
- Cutting down grass, oat or wheat looks a bit better now.
- Some of the traders introduced daily limits of wares bought from Kasimir.
- Reloading the game no longer restocks our industrious villagers.
- Kasimir has learned to run blindly in chosen direction (new auto run button).
- Access ramps to sheds are now rotating to better connect with uneven terrain.
- Kasimir knows how to name his farm animals (so it's harder to let them go).
- Kasimir decided it's a great idea to decorate his farm animals with hats (so he can distinguish one individual from another).
- Unclear information about state of soil, crops, animals is less unclear now.
- Farm animals started to leave... "gifts". You can use it to fill manure box which stopped to be an infinite source of fertilizer.
- Just like the compost box. You can fill it with cut grass, straw, oat and wheat.
- Another batch of bugs making loading a game impossible has been eliminated thanks to your support.
- You can fatten farm animals now and sell them with profit (soon, so keep them well fed!)
- Grenade collectors rejoice! They will no longer disappear from your shelves! (But those that already gone are lost forever, sorry about that).
- Villagers angry with Kasimir start a fight automatically.
- Fights are quicker and opponents fake attacks sometimes.

[h3]Coming in next update (very soon)[/h3]
- There is a new machine in Zalesie: Heavy plow (with three blades!). And no horse is able to pull it.

notes.title: Update 0.5.54
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- All the bugs we know of (thanks to You) that are making loading the game impossible were eliminated.
- Autosave feature has been added.
- The latest savegame files are now stored in Steam Cloud.
- You don't need to know a secret way to keep the settings changed in the game from reverting after you restart the game.
- Changing settings in the game no longer leaved you "blocked" (until you press Escape once more).
- After a session at an animal whisperer our animal flock abandoned their dreams of a circus career and it should behave more like an animal flock.
- You can put much more hay, straw and oat on the cart (using a fork). Even if can't see a space for more just keep on throwing.
- The slaughter station in the barn was thoroughly checked and improves. Especially regarding saving while animal processing was still in progress.
- In Zalesie, nice weather is a bit more frequent and it changes more often.
- Kasimir has mastered his kitchen to perfection and all the 'cold' operations are now done instantly.
- Kasimir has manned up and doesn't collapse even when he's dead tired (but nothing can force him to run when that happens).
- Kasimir has no mercy for the old willows now and may cut them down at will (apple trees are still safe, but not for long...)
- Sophia has a rifle for sale (for her favorite clients only).
- Steven has a ladder for sale. Unfortunately you cannot climb a ladder while holding another ladder in hands.
- New dream hints appear in Kasimir's dreams when he finally goes to sleep.
- Some dirt roads were covered with snow by some prankster, even at summer! He finally gave up on this.
- Magical force repelling  ladders from christmas trees is no longer present in Zalesie.

notes.title: Update 0.5.53
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Time flows much slower in Zalesie now.
- Disarming mines is easier if you're drunk (!)
- Priest Matthew performed more exorcisms over our possessed bicycle. It should not disappear anymore. Nor should it loose its interactivity.
- Kasimir learned how to build a Master Switch, so he can switch off electricity on entire electrified plot of land.
- Kasimir learned how to repair broken items himself in a workshop he can build in one of his sheds.
- The animals are no longer smart enough to notice tiny gaps in the gates and use them to escape from their pens.
- Some sheds were able to make saving the game impossible. They are fixed now.
- If you managed to electrify a spot before a quest told you to then the game will accept the job as completed.
- The mayor finally gave up on snow removal from main roads during winter. What a stubborn fellow....
- Villagers learned how to shake the snow off them.
- Baits for snares were improved. Every wild animal has a unique favourite food now.
- We restored holstering equipped items using quick access keys (thanks anderson!).
- The moon was stolen! Culprits were punished and nights in Zalesie got less dark again.
- We changed the water in the ponds from salty to fresh. Thanks to this, they finally freeze up properly in winter.
- Several game elements were optimized to improve general performance.
- Multiple minor bugs were eliminated.

notes.title: Update 0.5.52
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Electricity payment bug is fixed. Visit the mayor, pay all the bills once (even if they are zero!). This will make the system start working properly and the mayor will require payments every 4 months. You can pay every month if you like.
- Item durability was increased. A 'do it yourself' workshop is on its way and will arrive with the next small update.
- Some quests which didn't start properly or didn't become available at all are working properly now.
- Bunker doors opened without a crowbar no longer cause errors.
- Under some circumstances there was no giftbox under the christmas tree after completing event. It shows up now no matter what.
- German translation was updated.

notes.title: Update 0.5.51
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- The light came to Zalesie. At least for villagers not afraid of electricity.
- Christmas are here to stay. It's a good idea to visit priest Matthew every December.
- Kasimir has lost more of the sentinemts. This time regarding old stuff lying around the farm. You can finally remove all of it.
- The tools of Zalesie lost their legendary indestructibility. They get damaged when being used. Luckily some of the villagers know how to repair them.
- Distilerries no longer switch to cider production when they run out of mash.
- Someone greased the doorframes of Kasimir's barn, that's why you couldn't paint it. The grease was removed and so the barn may become perfectly beautiful now.
- You can see unknown recipes in your kitchen (but you can't use them untill you learn them from the villagers while completing their errands)
- Kasimir has sorted the kitchen recipes alphabetically.
- Helen figured out two new tasks for Kasimir.
- She's the only one possessing a recipe for mead beverage. She also sells and buys (almost) all booze types and mashes.
- Immobile cart connected to a tractor no longer scares all the animals around. They may eat and sleep around it now.
- Animals forgot how to escape from tightly closed pens built by Kasimir.
- For those of you who like to have lots of active lamps lying around we added a new visual setting 'Lamp shadows'. If your game lags try changing it. Dynamic shadows are evil.
- Items taken from bunkers no longer become invisible when taken far from the bunkers they came from.
- Another batch of bugs making saving the game impossible was eliminated thanks to our players.
- Invisible trunks staying after cut trees and removed roots are even more removed now.
- Black circles on the snow coming from the invisible trees were covered with snow thoroughly. 

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
- Yes, the horses still walk in the air... If you know how to reliably make them act like this, please let us know!
- If your savegame doesn't load send it to us via support mail

notes.title: Update 0.5.50
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Kasimir obtained tools to make the world around him more colorful (ask Steven)
- Kasimir sharpened his scythes, so they can remove bigger bushes and even smaller trees
- Kasimir learned a new look at fertilizing and sowing over broader areas

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 0.5.341
notes.notes:
We think we may have found the reason of disappearing interactions.
Thanks to one of our players (there was no nick in the report, sorry) we got our hands on a savegame file that gave us a solid lead on the issue.
Some physical objects falling through terrain into infinity caused object detection failure.
In this patch we keep all the objects in check.
If you still loose interactions please let us know!
And if you have a savegame that breaks interactions when loaded, please, do send it to us!

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 0.5.32
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
- Time flows slower in Zalesie from now on.
- Potato beetle that was destroying the savegame files was eradicated. Potatoes grow healthy and save properly.
- "Report a bug" lets you send you latest savegame file.
- Killed animals stored inside crates no longer corrupt savegame files.
- Cutting down trees and leaving them on the ground unfinished doesn't block saving the game anymore.
- The bike still likes to jump wildly from time to time, but it always gets back where Kasimir has left it.
- Kasimir no longer flies away while working the plow.
- Relations with other villagers are no longer forgotten when saving the game.
- Tractor was possessed by a demon consuming the fuel with the engine off. It was exorcised away properly (and fuel usage got lowet too).
- Tractor is not so fragile anymore. Even a nasty crash destroys less parts now.
- Tractor is not scaring villagers anymore (it was the fuel demons fault).
- Korean and Chinese fonts have been generated from scratch and no longer display "squares".
- Tiringly loud running footsteps sounds in the barn are no longer tiringly loud.
- "Take all" could generate bugs from time to time, but is much safer now.
- NPC that hates you very much will let you know about it if you try to talk to him instead being silent and uninteractive.
- Collection quests mind currently equipped items too from now on.
- Helpful villagers no longer refill tanks and crates with useful stuff for Kazimir to exploit.
- Errors appearing for no apparent reason were caused by... foggy weather. It's fixed now.
- Slaughter bench in the barn got more anti-bug safeguards.
- The bags of items you throw out during tutorial stages stay available to you, so you can recover the items.
- The lamps found in the bunkers behave like normal lamps instead acting like little magical flames.
- Coffee was nerfed.
- Many other minor tweaks and fixes.

[h3][b]Known issues:[/b][/h3]
- Disappearing interactions are still here and remain unpunished (When that happens try to sleep in a bed or save and reload the game).
- If your latest savegame turns interactions off, please, send it to us using "Report a bug" tool!

[h3][b]Workarounds:[/b][/h3]
- If your animal is stuck try to lead it and use fast travel. It will reset itself.
- If your cart is stuck try to pull it and use fast travel. It will reset itself.
- If your tractor or bike is stuck ride it and use fast travel, It will reset itself.
